Peff Academy

Our Focus

Peff Academy is an educational services and resources provider dedicated to supporting structured learning and educational preparation.

We provide lessons, courses, notes, study and practice materials, and other educational resources designed to promote conceptual understanding, knowledge development, and effective preparation.

Our scope encompasses academic subjects, competitions, entrance examinations, educational boards, guidance and advice, skill development, career development, practical training, personal development, sports, esports, financial literacy, and other areas of education and training.

About Peff Academy

Legal Status

Peff Academy is currently not legally registered at the moment.

Ownership Structure

Peff Academy is privately owned & administered under PEFFUS Network.

Home / Lessons & Explanations / Mathematics / Mathematical Objects / Functions

Composite Functions

Posts

Post 1

Introduction to Composite Functions

This lesson introduces composite functions and explains how the output of one function can serve as the input of another. It covers the fundamental principles of function composition through mathematical notation, substitution, and domain restrictions.

Topics Covered
  • Definition and notation of composite functions
  • Understanding f(g(x)) & f∘g
  • Function composition through substitution
  • The significance of composition order
  • Variables as input placeholders
  • Domains and restrictions of composite functions

Presented by ZuskyTo, representing Peff Academy.
